correctness.rationale: The 20 vertices, 20 distinct ten-vertex facets and 16,141 total faces are exhaustively reconstructed. The 6814 elementary and 1233 toggle pairs are explicit; all 87,800 original Hasse incidences are sorted and prove an acyclic matching. The 13×32 signed integer Morse boundary has exactly two unit Smith factors. Since the resulting CW three-skeleton is a wedge of 13 three-spheres, Hurewicz and cellular cancellation prove the full ∨11 S³ ∨30 S⁴ homotopy equivalence; independent mod-two ranks on the collapsed core agree. Limits: one finite graph, dependent on executable and the stated combinatorial Morse/Hurewicz theorems.

value.rationale: The first middle-rank self-complementary Johnson graph is a canonical natural test case for the 2025 closed-neighborhood/Čech theory. The pure nine-dimensional complex has two different lower-dimensional integral sphere families, giving an exact mixed-dimensional topological benchmark, a substantive nonshellability obstruction, and a contrast to the already-classified Johnson radius-one Rips flag complex. These features are not routine substitutions, arbitrary slices or known-table recomputations.
